book.name: 1Qoronttoosa
book.title: Phawuloosa Qoronttoosa Asayis Xaafeez Tiina Kiita

content: Eko gelo bagga
Yi taas xaafeez dabiddaabbay bagga as maachch bochchaaminxikko lo77o.
Zini lagitapp attodayis pettay pettay machcho paas ekko; ma pettii pettii machchiskka azin yezo.
Azinay fa machchis, ma machchat fa azinayis beeziza baz udo.
Machchat fa asetithayil afa iis mawute baaya, zin mawute I azinayisi. Yey garkkekka, azinayis E asetithayil afa mawute baaya, zin mawutay machchatisi.
Yi woosar xiqqa wode gam7odayis zorer maaqqaam ixxiko, pettay petta kayppate. Yeypp denddeezayid yinttinatitha haarodayis gaminttin, Xalahe yinttan paaccaamay garkk pettipp yezoytta.
Zini taanii yinttan zorodayis yhaya geezaypp attin azazo baaya.
Asii ubbay ta garkk machcho ekkeka yezizako ta dosiza, zin Xoossay pettayis pettayis inggeez duma duma imotay yeza. Pettayis yhaygarkk yhankkayis hara imotay yeza.
Machcho ekkekkazitayisinnee azin gelekkazitayis ma am7itayis taanii gizay, ta garkk yezoytta gi zoriza.
Zini amor xuuginttodaypp ekkizaynnee gelizay lo77o maaqqeez gishos unttii fana haarodayis danda7aam ixxiko, ekkonne gelo.
Taanii ekkeezitayisinnee geleezitayis yhay garkk gi zoriza; tana baaya Goday azaziza; machchat fa azinaypp shaakinttippe.
Zini shaakinttiko hara azina gelekka fa ubbas yezo woy fa azinayira giigo. Azinay fa machchat billippe.
Zini yhankkitayis Goda baazin taanii yhay garkk giza. Ammanoowa machcha yez ammaniza azinay yeziko, machchat ezar pettipp yezodayis koyko izo billippe.
Ma ammanoowa azinii yez ammaniza machcha yeziko, I azinay iir pettipp yezodayis koyko eepp bilinttippee.
Ammanoowa azinay fa ammaniza machchat baggar geezhiza; ma ammanoowa machchat fa ammaniza azinay baggar geezhiza. Yeya baazako, yi na7itay tuna maaqqiza, zin yhatti unttii geeshshii.
Zini ammanoowa azina woy machchat billodayis koyko billo. Ammaniza machcha woy azinay yey garkk bazar acinttippe. Xoossay nuna sarotithar yezoday garkk xeegeeza.
Ammaniza astte, ammanoowa ne azinay ne baggar ammanodazako ne erinee? Woy ammaniza athayyo, ammanoowa ne machchat ne baggar ammanodazako ne erinee?
Pettii pettii as Goday ees inggeez imotay garkkennee Xoossay eza xeegeezay garkk yeza. Woosa keeth ubbayid taanii taamarsseez wogay yhaya.
Oonkka dookalinttii xeegintteezibaz maaqqiko, dookalintteekazay garkk hanippee. Dooaolintteka ammaneez oonkka yeziko, dookalinttodayis koyppe.
Xooss kiita polodayis beezizaypp attin dookalinttin dookalinttaam ixxin akkosikka adooya.
Pettii pettii as Xoossay fana xeegeez wode yezan garkk yeza.
Xoossay nena xeegeez wode neenii aylle? Akkokka baaya yeyiss un77inttippe. Zini neenii aylletithapp wozinttodayis danda7iko wozinttoba.
Aylle maaqqii yezar Godar xeegintteez as Godaypp denddeezayid aylletithapp wozintteeza. Yey garkkekka, aylle maaqqekka yezar, Godayir xeegintteez as Kiristtoosa aylle.
Xoossay yinttan gate ciggi wongeez gishos as aylle maaqqipatte.
Ta ishuntho, yi pettay pettay xeegintteez wode yez yessayir Xoossar wolla yezoytta.
Ekkekka, gelekka asay baggannee am7itay bagga
Wudiritayinnee paanthitay bagga Goday tana azazeez bazi baaya. Zini Goday taas inggeez maarotithay garkk taanii yinttan zoriza.
Yikkee, yha wodayid yez metay gishos ekkeka woy gelekka yessi taas lo77o aaziza.
Ne machcho ekkeez baz maaqqiko, anjjodayis koyppe. Ne machcho ekkekkabaz maaqqiko, ekkodayis koyppe.
Zini ne machcho ekkiko nagara baaya. Yey garkk wudirttakka azin geliko nagara baaya. Zini ekkiza geliza asayis yha sa7a iita meto yeza gishos yi yeypp attoday garkk ta koyiza.
Ta ishuntho, ta gizay yeya; wode wureeza. Yikkepp tiina machcha yezay machcho ekkekkazay garkk yezo.
Yeekkizitay yeekkoozitay garkk maaqqo, ufayttizitay ufayttoozitay garkk, wonggizitay akkokka baazitay garkk fana payido.
Yha sa7a shalor maadinttinttizitay maaddinttoozitay garkk maaqqo. Yha alame malay aadhoda.
Yi hirgga bayth yezoday garkk ta dosiza. Machcho ekkekazay Goda ufayssodayis koyiz gishos Godaybaz qoppiza.
Zini machcho ekkeezay fa machchato ufayssodayis koyiz gishos yha sa7abaz qoppiza.

E qofay nam77ii aqo shaakinttiza. Azin gelekka wudirtta fa asetithayrannee fa shemppayid geezhii Goda ufayssodayis koyeez gishos Godaybaz qoppiza. Zini azin geleezana fa azina ufayssodayis koyiz gishos sa7abaz qoppiza.
Taanii yeya yinttis odeeza, yi maadinttoday garkkepp attin xike gancce gelii yi un77inttoday garkk baaya. Zini yi qofay laalinttekka maarar yezii Goda ufayssiza baz yi udod garkk taanii odiza.
Oonkka fa oycceez wudirtto gelo wode aadheeza gi izo ashshodayis qoppiko, yeyi ma iis lo77o baazay si7inttiko, fa koyeeza ootho; u woli ekkiko, geliko; yey nagara baaya.
Zini pettii as un77ithiza baz dhabiko, fa wozinayir miinggii, fana haarii, fa oycceez wudirtto ekkeka ashshodayis koykko lo77o udeeza.
Yeyi gishos, wudirttona ekkeez athay lo77o ootheeza; ma ekkeka athay ubbar lo77o ootheeza.
Machchata azinay paxa yez wode ubbayid ezar accintteezano. Zini I azinay yhayqqiko, fa doseez azina gelodayis danda7iza. Hano zin, iza geliza athay ammaniza as maaqqodayis beeziza.
Ta qofar maaqqiko, iza gelekka yeziko ufayisar yezoda. Ma taas, taar Xoossa Ayyana yeza aaziza.
